name: onfreq
description: Self-hosted IVAO air traffic control Discord bot with live ATC session cards and FIR coverage, built with TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Create your own bot in the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications), then copy its token from the **Bot** page. Keep this secret.

DISCORD_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Enable **Developer Mode** in Discord, right-click each destination text channel and select **Copy Channel ID**. Separate multiple IDs with commas. Invite the bot with View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links and Read Message History.

FIR_PREFIXES.description: Enter the ICAO callsign prefixes you want to monitor, separated by commas. Each prefix must contain 1–4 letters. Choose your own airspace; there is no default region.

POLL_SECRET.description: Generate and save a random secret with your password manager or `openssl rand -hex 32`. It protects health checks and manual polling. Never reuse your Discord token or commit this value.

ATC_STATE.description: Private cache for this installation. Cloudflare creates a KV namespace automatically.

POLL_COORDINATOR.description: Stores session state and coordinates polling. Cloudflare creates the Durable Object binding automatically.
